contents.markdown: If you find that managing the VPS is annoying, I host a similar Pelican blog by uploading everything directly to a CDN and using edge rules for anything fancy (like your redirects or Markdown content negotiation). I use BunnyCDN because [their storage zones are fast even for cache misses](https://www.brendanlong.com/even-faster-website-with-bunny-cdn-and-micromorph.html), and Claude can configure it with Terraform.
